I implemented `minidb/executor.py`. 13 of the 14 tests in `tests/test_executor.py` pass. `test_insert_reports_no_rows` fails, and it can't pass alongside another test.

`test_insert_reports_no_rows` expects an INSERT to return `row_count` 0. `test_insert_without_columns_passes_values_through` expects 1 for the same call. The task description and the docstring both say INSERT returns 1, so I kept 1. I did not edit the test file because it is read-only, so that one test will keep failing.
